title: Earning the trust of the space kids

tellings.quote: It took about 2 years [music] for me to basically earn the trust of these space kids.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells Michels that it took him about two years to win the trust of a group of people he calls "these space kids", whom he interviewed for a film. He speaks from his own experience doing the interviews, and he does not say on this point who the space kids are or why they were so wary.
